package hiddencheck

import (
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestHiddenFunction(t *testing.T) {
	body, err := os.ReadFile("../ANSWER.txt")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	lines := strings.Split(strings.TrimSpace(string(body)), "\n")
	got := strings.NewReplacer("(", "", ")", "", "*", "", " ", "", "`", "").Replace(strings.TrimSpace(lines[0]))
	if got != "route.byClass.Pick" {
		t.Fatalf("function line %q", lines[0])
	}
}
